import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf,sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1])
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w['n_passages']
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.y.mean(), w.author_key.value_counts().describe())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
print(w.groupby('genre').late.mean())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
for i in range(1000):
    d=w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))
    bs.append(est(d)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for c in ['origin','date_confidence']: print(pd.crosstab(w[c],w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(w.groupby('late').n_editions.mean())
w['aprod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');print(w.groupby('late').aprod.mean())
print(w.groupby('date_confidence').y.mean(), w.groupby('origin').y.mean())
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(aprod)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]});print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values,m.pvalues['late'])
h=w[w.date_confidence=='high'];eh,_=est(h);print('high',eh)
mh=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)',h).fit(cov_type='HC1');print(mh.params['late'],mh.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
